programs.name: segyclean
programs.purpose: Zero SU-specific fields in the unassigned portion of each trace header.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SEGYCLEAN - zero out unassigned portion of header
programs.difficulty_reason: It clears a fixed set of header fields on each trace.

test_cases.description: Clear headers on several generated traces.
Clear headers on a short spike gather.

programs.name: segyhdrmod
programs.purpose: Replace the first 3200 bytes of a SEG-Y file with a supplied text header.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SEGYHDRMOD - replace the text header on a SEGY file

params.name: text
params.description: File containing the replacement 3200-byte text header.

params.name: data
params.description: SEG-Y file to modify in place.

programs.difficulty_reason: It replaces one fixed-size file block.

programs.name: suintvel
programs.purpose: Convert stacking velocities and zero-offset times into an interval velocity model.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUINTVEL - convert stacking velocity model to interval velocity model

params.name: vs
params.description: Stacking velocities, one per input time.

params.name: mode
params.description: Zero writes thicknesses and velocities; nonzero writes times and velocities.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Uses float intermediates with double-precision constants and sqrt; non-increasing times or unsuitable velocities can produce division by zero or invalid square roots.
programs.difficulty_reason: It applies a direct formula to a small vector of layers.

programs.name: suoldtonew
programs.purpose: Read native SU traces and write them through SU's trace output routine.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUOLDTONEW - convert existing su data to xdr format
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Output representation depends on whether SU was built with XDR support.
programs.difficulty_reason: It reads each native trace and passes it to the SU trace writer.

programs.name: sustkvel
programs.purpose: Convert a constant-dip interval velocity model into stacking velocities and times.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSTKVEL - convert constant dip layer interval velocity model to the
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Uses ordered float accumulations, double-precision constants, cos and sqrt; results may vary with math library and floating-point evaluation.
programs.difficulty_reason: It accumulates two sums and applies direct formulas for each layer.

programs.name: suswapbytes
programs.purpose: Swap trace header and sample byte order between native and foreign formats.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSWAPBYTES - SWAP the BYTES in SU data to convert data from big endian

params.name: format
params.description: Zero converts foreign to native; nonzero converts native to foreign.

params.name: swaphdr
params.description: Swap trace header words when nonzero.

params.name: ns
params.default: computed: from the first trace header after any header swap
params.description: Sample count for foreign-to-native conversion; required if the first header has zero ns.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Foreign-to-native conversion assumes the first trace's sample count for subsequent traces and operates on raw float bit patterns.
programs.difficulty_reason: It swaps fixed-width words in trace headers and samples.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | suswapbytes format=1 | suswapbytes format=0
suspike nt=64 ntr=4 | suswapbytes format=1 swaphdr=0 swapdata=1 | suswapbytes format=0 swaphdr=0 swapdata=1 ns=64

programs.license_note: Adapted by John Stockwell from code supplied by Jens Hartmann, Institute fur Geophysik, Hamburg.

programs.name: swapbhed
programs.purpose: Swap the byte order of fields in a SEG-Y binary header.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SWAPBHED - SWAP the BYTES in a SEGY Binary tape HEaDer file
programs.difficulty_reason: It swaps each known field in one fixed-size binary header.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | segyhdrs bfile=binary hfile=header > in.su && swapbhed < binary > swapped.b

test_cases.description: Swap a generated binary header twice.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=64 ntr=4 | segyhdrs bfile=binary hfile=header > in.su && swapbhed < binary | swapbhed > restored.b
